name: Vieer Dwivedi
headline: DEVOPS / MLOPS ENGINEER
summary: DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of AWS and Azure experience, specializing in cloud automation, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. Experienced in building and operating production AI infrastructure, including AWS Bedrock-based generative AI solutions.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer / MLOps
bullets: Built multi-account AWS setups with Organizations, Control Tower, VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, IGW, NAT, Security Groups, NACLs, Route 53, CloudFront, ALB/NLB/ELB and Auto Scaling; ran EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS, Fargate, Batch, App Runner, API Gateway, AppSync and Cognito.

Managed S3, EBS, EFS, FSx, AWS Backup, RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and ElastiCache for HA/DR; built pipelines with EventBridge, SNS, SQS, Step Functions, Amazon MQ, Kinesis, Glue, Athena, Redshift, OpenSearch and EMR.
Built AI infrastructure on Amazon Bedrock (Agents, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Model Evaluation, Converse API, Runtime, Titan, FMs) with SageMaker and Amazon Q.
Automated infrastructure with Terraform, Terragrunt, CloudFormation, CDK, Python and Bash on Ubuntu, cutting provisioning from days to under 30 minutes.

Built CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodeCommit, Harness, Spinnaker, Tekton, Argo Workflows and Argo CD (GitOps), using blue-green, canary and rolling releases.
Ran EKS with Helm, Kustomize, Istio, Karpenter, HPA, NGINX Ingress, Network Policies and RBAC.
Secured platforms with SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, Checkov, IAM, KMS, ACM, Secrets Manager, Parameter Store, WAF, Shield, GuardDuty, Inspector, Security Hub, Macie, Detective, Config, CloudTrail and SSM.

Implemented observability with Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Promtail, Alloy, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, X-Ray, Fluent Bit, Vector, CloudWatch, Datadog, Alertmanager and PagerDuty, with SLO/SLI alerting and RCA.
Cut cloud spend by ~28% using Cost Explorer, Budgets, Compute Optimizer, Trusted Advisor and the Well-Architected Tool.
Flagship project - GenAI Platform with Python MCP Framework on Bedrock. Problem: teams built one-off AI integrations with no guardrails or cost visibility, and each agent took weeks to set up.

Flagship project - Solution: built a reusable Python MCP server framework on Bedrock, deployed on EKS via Terraform, GitHub Actions and Argo CD (canary), secured with IAM, KMS, WAF, Guardrails and Trivy, and monitored with OpenTelemetry, Grafana and PagerDuty.
Flagship project - Impact: onboarding went from weeks to days, uptime stayed at 99.9%+, and inference cost fell ~25%.

Automated with ARM, Bicep, Ansible and Shell on RHEL/Ubuntu, cutting manual effort by ~60%.

Delivered via Azure DevOps (Pipelines, Repos, Artifacts) and migrated Jenkins, TeamCity, Bamboo, Travis CI, CircleCI, Drone CI and Bitbucket Pipelines, with Git, GitHub, Bitbucket, Gerrit, SVN, branching and release management; added SAST/DAST and dependency and container scanning.

Used Docker, Compose, Swarm, containerd, Podman, Docker Hub, and Kubernetes on AKS, GKE, OpenShift, Rancher, K3s, Kops, Minikube and Kind; managed StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PV/PVC, Ingress, Operators, Cluster Autoscaler, VPA, Linkerd, Consul and Flux CD.

Built ELK/EFK, OpenSearch, Fluentd, Splunk, Dynatrace, New Relic, AppDynamics, Nagios, Zabbix, Sensu, Zipkin, Azure Monitor, App Insights, Log Analytics, Google Cloud Operations and Opsgenie monitoring, cutting MTTR by ~35%.

Flagship project - Solution: standardized on Azure DevOps with Docker, AKS, Helm, Flux CD, Bicep, Key Vault and Defender, with unified logging and APM in Azure Monitor and ELK.
Flagship project - Impact: seven tools became one pipeline, releases dropped from hours to minutes, and MTTR fell ~35%.
